standard.title: Beehives — Specification (मधुमक्खी पेटिका — विशिष्टि) (Fourth Revision)
standard.description: This standard prescribes the constructional requirements, dimensional limits, and timber joint specifications for Type A, Type B, and Type C beehives used in apiculture.
standard.scope: This standard prescribes the constructional requirements, dimensional limits, and timber joint specifications for Type A, Type B, and Type C beehives used in apiculture.

amendments.summary: No active amendments have been issued on this standard (NIL on this copy).

certification.description: Voluntary Product Specification. Manufacturers are encouraged to apply for the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) to print on product packaging as a certified assurance of quality. Additionally, compliance with the dimensions, joint construction, and engraving parameters of the beehive is strictly mandated in central and state agricultural department tenders, honey-bee colony development subsidies, and apiary training packages across India.
requirements: Prescribes structural and dimensional requirements for three standardized types of beehives: Type A, Type B, and Type C.

To facilitate handling and transport on-site, grooves or notches must be cut on the outer faces of the front and rear walls of the brood chamber. These notches must be positioned exactly in the centers of the outer faces.
The four sides of the brood chamber must be securely joined together using one of four approved joint profiles: special box corner, finger, dovetail, or tongue and groove joints.

Super chamber dimensions must conform to Tables 1 to 7. A rabbet measuring 10 mm wide and 16 mm deep must be cut at the top and towards the inner surface in both the front and rear walls of the chamber.
The ends of the super frame (often having a bar 10 mm thick and 448 mm long) must be fitted with a groove measuring 10 mm × 10 mm to accommodate the tongue of the side bar.

Each major component of the hive must be clearly and indelibly engraved with: a) Name of the part and its size (e.g., Brood chamber, Type A, Bee space 8 mm); b) Trade-mark, if any; c) Batch or code number; d) Name of the manufacturer; and e) Date of manufacture.

Any observed or calculated test or dimension value must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be identical to the specified value in the standard.
